structured.answer: If I did it, I'd hold it with פסגות and the "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500" fund. The page says that leaves 179,889 ₪ after 15 years at 750 ₪ a month (135,000 ₪ paid in), "בכסף של היום", if the dollar doesn't move. I couldn't find what inflation rate it uses, and the "אינפלציה" button did nothing, so I'd ask my son before doing anything.

stuck.where: Grey 'אינפלציה' button next to the 'בכסף של היום' line
stuck.why: I pressed it twice and nothing visible changed. No inflation rate is shown anywhere I looked.
It doesn't say if 7% is before or after price rises, so I can't tell what 'בכסף של היום' really means.

stuck.where: Bar chart and fund list under the result
stuck.why: Too many colours, labels and red minus numbers. I got anxious and stopped.

Result card: הפקדתם 135,000 ₪, הבחירה שלכם · הזול 179,889 ₪, 'נשאר לכם בעוד 15 שנים, אחרי דמי ניהול ומס, בכסף של היום'
Account name פסגות ניירות ערך בע"מ and fund name ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500

Labels like צוברת, עסקת החלף, מנוטרלת מט״ח, קרן חוץ בת״א

unsure_meaning: מדד (stock index, not the price index)
בכסף של היום – at what inflation?
not_found: The inflation rate the page assumes
Whether 7% a year is before or after inflation
Any comparison with a bank deposit or a safe option

findings.what: The inflation rate used for 'בכסף של היום' isn't shown, and the 'אינפלציה' button seems to do nothing when pressed
It doesn't say whether the 7% return is before or after inflation
Dark background with small grey text is hard to read even enlarged
findings.where: Whole page, especially the lines under the result numbers and the explanation in the account panel

findings.what: Red minus amounts all down the fund list are alarming, and I can't tell what they're measured against
The page opens with English index names and the word מדד, and doesn't speak to someone who saves in deposits
Many close colours in the cost bar chart and legend, so I couldn't tell them apart
Lots of jargon labels on every fund
findings.where: Fund chips (צוברת, עסקת החלף, מנוטרלת מט״ח)

findings.what: 'אם הדולר לא זז מול השקל' is an important condition, but it's in small text
